title: Goldfish dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water swirls -->
  <path d="M8 72 Q20 62 32 72 Q44 82 56 72 Q68 62 80 72 Q92 82 96 74" fill="none" stroke="#2ec4c4" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M4 84 Q16 74 28 84 Q40 94 52 84 Q64 74 76 84 Q88 94 98 86" fill="none" stroke="#1a9e9e" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d="M22 48 Q8 30 4 20 Q16 28 30 42 Z" fill="#ff6a1a"/>
  <path d="M22 52 Q6 56 2 70 Q16 60 30 54 Z" fill="#e05500"/>
  <path d="M22 48 Q10 40 8 32 Q18 38 30 44 Z" fill="#ffb347"/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="48" rx="28" ry="18" fill="#ff8c1a"/>
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="44" rx="24" ry="13" fill="#ffb347"/>
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="40" rx="16" ry="7" fill="#ffd47a"/>

  <!-- side fin waving -->
  <path d="M48 58 Q44 70 36 74 Q46 76 54 64 Z" fill="#ff6a1a"/>
  <path d="M48 58 Q46 68 40 72 Q48 70 54 62 Z" fill="#ffb347"/>

  <!-- top fin dancing -->
  <path d="M42 31 Q46 18 54 16 Q52 26 50 31 Z" fill="#e05500"/>
  <path d="M48 30 Q54 16 62 18 Q58 26 54 31 Z" fill="#ff6a1a"/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx="68" cy="42" r="6" fill="#fff3e0"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="42" r="3.2" fill="#1b1b3a"/>
  <circle cx="71" cy="41" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- happy mouth -->
  <path d="M70 52 Q74 58 80 54" fill="none" stroke="#c23a00" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx="84" cy="34" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#7fe3e3" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="22" r="2.2" fill="none" stroke="#7fe3e3" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="24" r="1.6" fill="none" stroke="#7fe3e3" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- little dancing shoes -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="76" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="74" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
  <path d="M34 74 Q30 70 32 66" fill="none" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M66 72 Q70 68 68 64" fill="none" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
